candidate_commit_resolution_note: Pin the full SHA in the external G1_C3_COMMIT_MANIFEST.json supplied at handoff. This commit cannot contain its own SHA. Do not resolve a moving branch as the audited SHA.
entrypoint: python -B -m semgrepai (semgrepai.__main__ -> semgrepai.cli:app in prepared fork)
changes_in_g1_c2: Derived verified Windows <-> WSL2 `/mnt/<drive>/<rel_source_root>=<source_root>` path mappings strictly from trusted `source_root` in `v2/g1_integration/bridge.py` (plus optional `--path-map` CLI passthrough validated inside `source_root`), eliminating the 11 `POSIX/WSL source path requires an explicit --path-map` failures observed on ADMIN-PC in G1-C1 while preserving `opengrep.json`, `opengrep.sarif`, and `dataflow_trace` 100% lossless.

Hardened `v2/triage/ollama.py` and `v2/triage/heuristics.py` to compare citations, enclosing-method/callee scopes, unreachable dead-branch lines, and wrong-context/invalid sanitizer checks against the Evidence-verified canonical relative path bound to `snapshots` rather than raw `record['path']`.

Added regression and security boundary tests covering valid WSL2 mapping, native Windows paths, pure POSIX mode, arbitrary POSIX paths, cross-drive paths, forged sibling prefixes, `..` traversal, escaping directory junctions/symlinks, SHA-256 mismatches, out-of-scope/dead-branch citations, and invalid-sanitizer `REFUTED` rejections.
setup_instructions: 1. Pin the full G1-C3 handoff SHA in a separate detached checkout; do not detach the development worktree. See README section 5 for offline setup.
2. Verify or clone clean upstream `https://github.com/hardw00t/simple_semgrepAI.git` checked out at `2c79a58a16d11e9dea3723e30d2a7faffba7bdc9`.

3. Prepare the G1 fork into a fresh private directory outside Git: `python -B -m v2.g1_integration.prepare_g1_fork --upstream <UPSTREAM_DIR> --advisor-dir <PRIVATE_ADVISOR_DIR> --output-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/fork-g1` (or pass `--scanner-layer ntk-cleanroom` if running on a clean server without the private advisor ZIP).
run_instructions: G1 integrated local triage: `python -B -m semgrepai scan v2/g1_integration/demo_fixtures/Demo1TruePositive.java --rules-path v2/g1_integration/rules/java_g1_cwe22_cwe89.yml --output-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/g1-run --executable <OPENGREP_BIN> --local-triage --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M --prompt-contract blind --timeout 180`

Human review queue lifecycle: `python -B -m semgrepai queue --db <PRIVATE_OUT>/g1-run/triage/review.sqlite`, `show <ID>`, `confirm-true <ID> --actor <ACTOR> --reason <REASON>`, `confirm-false <ID> --actor <ACTOR> --reason <REASON>`, `reopen <ID> --actor <ACTOR> --reason <REASON>`, `history <ID> --include-rejected`

Full 4-scenario reproducible demo: `python -B -m v2.g1_integration.run_g1_demo --prepared-source <PRIVATE_OUT>/fork-g1/source --output-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/demo-suite --executable <OPENGREP_BIN> --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M --timeout 180`

required_environment.opengrep: Local OpenGrep CLI binary (>=1.20.0, native or WSL2 wrapper); Semgrep is rejected by design
required_environment.ollama: Local loopback HTTP Ollama at http://127.0.0.1:11434 (verify installed model tags via /api/tags; server reference model is qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M; on Windows+WSL2 keep a WSL session active during HTTP calls so WSL2 does not auto-suspend)

expected_independent_verdict_paths.javis_runtime: Future separately authorized G1-C3 runtime bundle

known_limitations: G1-C2 remains G1_C2_RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE_FAILED. G1-C3 REAL_OLLAMA and runtime criteria R01-R03 are NOT_TESTED; independent audit and operator approval remain required.

Java context extraction is bounded to the enclosing method and same-file helper callees (<=150 lines); cross-file callees are treated as unresolved external calls and fail closed to UNDETERMINED when safety is claimed.
CLI `--actor` is an unauthenticated operator string for local audit trail, and SQLite does not claim OS-level tamper resistance against privileged local users.
Historical G0 findings and 14 pending errata remain untouched and locked (`G0_ACCEPTANCE=CONDITIONAL`, `READY_FOR_G1=CONDITIONAL`, historical Arm C independent contribution `CONFOUNDED`).

offline_test_environment.python: Prefer Python 3.11 for ADMIN-PC parity. Development verification uses an isolated Python 3.12.3 AMD64 venv authorized by the operator; Python 3.11 parity remains NOT_TESTED.
offline_test_environment.git: Only per-command exact safe.directory allowed for the development worktree; audit helper already supplies per-checkout -c safe.directory. Never change global configuration.
skip_conditions: OpenGrep integration test skips if binary unavailable; no real Ollama is run by these suites.
Live upstream proof skips unless NTK_M1_LIVE_UPSTREAM and NTK_M1_ADVISOR_DIR are supplied; do not access old PRIVATE data.
Symlink test may skip if Windows account cannot create symlinks.
